description: Guardrails for the delivery loop. Enforces the hard rules from copilot-instructions.md so autonomous slices (P3) and auto-recovery (P5) cannot take unsafe shortcuts.

hooks.message: Direct pushes to main are not allowed. Use a feature branch and open a PR.
Bypassing verification hooks is not allowed. Fix the failing checks instead.

hooks.when: diff adds source files but no test files changed
hooks.message: Opening a PR without tests for new behavior. The loop requires tests before merge (P4).
